description: Original bounded civilization balance, including an original G7 content set (forty technologies in six eras, thirty units with separate attack, defence and ranged values, roles, role bonuses and upgrades, twenty-five buildings, Saltpeter and Oil, per-tile strategic quantities and the Well improvement), an original promotion set with experience thresholds, original city-combat values and Siege-unit siege percentages, original terrain-feature and river values, eight original world wonders with empire effects and golden-age values, original barbarian values (owner marker, camp timing and caps, unit caps, era unit kinds, camp reward and experience cap), passable food-yielding Tundra, indexed integration of original coherent terrain/resource generation, weighted shortest paths, visibility projection and strict versioned save schema (optional unit experience and validated promotions, an optional city strike round and city-strike event fields, optional tile features and symmetric river edge masks validated against hex or sphere topology, an optional per-player golden-age record, optional wonder event fields and once-per-world wonder placement, an optional barbarian camp record with barbarian-owned units and events, unit movement in multiples of 1/6, accepting every earlier whole/half-move save). Uses separately attributed HexMath; not converted Unciv rules or map generation and no copied media or full parity claim.
